call_points.text: Substantive revenue from new lines is guided to show from Q3FY27, with Q2 described as machines running at full throttle.
Baker Hughes 7,600 sq m facility inaugurated April 2026, the fourth dedicated OEM plant after Mitsubishi, GE and Siemens.
Civil construction of remaining units to finish this fiscal; post-FY29 capex quantum deferred to next quarter.
Turbojet engine delivered to GTRE; weapon testing 4-6 weeks away, then worthiness certification for production.
Hot-section facility for Mitsubishi is 7-8 months from establishment, then qualification; other OEMs already interested.
First Rolls-Royce civil engine qualification parts to be delivered within this quarter.
Raw material fell to 5% of sales from about 12% last year on domestic supplier qualification and freight savings.
Export receivables to be naturally hedged via foreign-currency loans and bill discounting by Q4.
Management named execution complexity, running factories, hiring and contracts together, as the main challenge.
Management reaffirmed 25%+ top-line revenue growth trajectory for FY27 and on a multi-year basis.
Signed 8-year contract with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries as single-source supplier for hot section Nozzle Vanes segments.
Inaugurated 4 dedicated facilities post-listing; the remaining 4 under-construction plants will be completed during FY27.
Targeting EBITDA margins of 33% to 35% plus, driven by continuous floor improvements and backward integration.
Targeting inventory reduction to closer to 200 days in H1FY27 and 160-170 days in H2FY27 as utilization ramps.
Approximately ₹100 Cr in accumulated capex GST credit expected to be realized by H1FY28, supporting liquidity.
Saudi Arabia capex timeline shifted to prioritize domestic capacity completion and ramp-up.

operating_notes.text: Inaugurated a 7,600 sq. m. dedicated lean manufacturing facility for Baker Hughes at Tunikibollaram, Hyderabad with ~230 professionals.
Signed Amendment No. 3 to the Baker Hughes Strategic Supply Agreement on April 23, 2026, due to increased annual demand for turbomachinery components.
FY26 capex totaled ₹572.48 Cr, up 95.2% YoY.
Order backlog of ~₹6,500 Cr split by segment: over $400M in Energy, $200M+ in Aerospace & Defence, and $100M+ in Oil & Gas.
Signed an 8-year contract with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries as single-source supplier for gas turbine hot section Nozzle Vanes.
Each of the eight dedicated plants at Tuniki Bollaram is poised to generate ₹150-180 Cr at full utilisation, about ₹1,200 Cr in total.
Debtor days are around 170-180 and are targeted down to 90 via bill discounting facilities.
Hiring runs at roughly 150-200 people a month through a 90-day training programme to build bench strength.

timeline.summary: Azad Engineering inaugurated a 7,600 sq. m. dedicated lean manufacturing facility for Baker Hughes at Tunikibollaram, Hyderabad.
Azad Engineering signed Amendment No. 3 to its Strategic Supply Agreement with Baker Hughes on April 23, 2026, to accommodate higher annual demand for turbomachinery components.
Rakesh Chopdar, Promoter of Azad Engineering Limited, declared no new encumbrances by the Promoter Group during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

Azad Engineering Limited will host an earnings conference call on **May 16, 2026**, at **12:00 PM (IST)** to discuss audited Q4 & FY2026 results, featuring **Mr. Rakesh Chopdar (Chairman & CEO), Mr. Vishnu Malpani (WTD), and Mr. Ronak Jajoo (CFO)**.
Azad Engineering reported ₹540.27 Cr utilized out of its ₹700 Cr QIP proceeds as of March 31, 2026, extending capex utilization timeline to March 31, 2027.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹161.54 Cr (+27.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹35.98 Cr (+42.4% YoY).
Azad Engineering Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 on May 16, 2026, signed digitally by **G. Praneeth Abhishek** and **Abhishek Gunda**.
Azad Engineering hosts Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 25%+ FY27 top-line growth and detailing an 8-year single-source Mitsubishi contract.

Azad Engineering's Q1FY27 call (Aug 8, 2026) reported standalone revenue up 26.8% YoY to ₹170.5 Cr at a 37.6% EBITDA margin, and flagged delivery of India's first indigenous turbojet engine to GTRE/DRDO.
